caseName: Florida East Coast Railway Co. v. United States
caseNameFull: FLORIDA EAST COAST RAILWAY CO. v. UNITED STATES
attorneys: A. Alvis Layne for appellant., Solicitor General Marshall, Assistant Attorney General Turner, Howard E. Shapiro, Robert W. Ginnane and Raymond M. Zimmet for the United States et al.; Richard A. Hollander for Seaboard Air Line Railroad Co.; and Thomas C. Britton and St. Julien P. Rosemond for Dade County et al., appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion of Dade County et al. to join Seaboard Air Line Railroad Company in its motion to affirm is. granted.

The motions to affirm are granted and thé judgment is affirmed.
